status: accepted within test/CI literal-colour ratchet scope
sourceAssessment: Exact path plus trimmed source context plus occurrence count prevents moving, duplicating, changing or reviving accepted literal sites under the fixed baseline. Stale entries fail until removed.

CI supplies validated PR base SHA or push predecessor; unavailable commits are fetched explicitly, invalid/missing refs fail. A baseline absent from the base is transparently initial adoption, not shrink evidence. The initial shared branch adoption still requires review.

Malformed/duplicate/zero-count/wildcard path entries fail. Symlink traversal is rejected. Scanner deliberately inspects Vue template/script/style/comments, skips only src/styles; no CSS or wallet production source change.
Replayed ten guard tests plus twenty existing palette/contrast cases. Tests include real Git retired-exception revival, invalid ref, same-file duplication and cross-line RGB channel changes.
limitations: No historical raw-colour debt closure: current203 occurrences versus plan179 and documented earlier180/191 are explicitly retained.

The lexical matcher is grep-like, not a CSS parser: nested functional/escaped syntax and other colour syntaxes are not a claim of complete colour semantic analysis. Current pinned baseline uses ordinary literal hex and flat rgb/rgba forms; introducing changed forms cannot reuse those exact source entries.
No remote GitHub execution, full suite, browser/render/packaging or production migration acceptance; Android/iOS guards are separate.
